# SpriteFlip

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · enum

```csharp
public enum SpriteFlip
```

Mirrors a sprite's image inside the rectangle it's drawn in, without moving the rectangle: the sprite flips in place whatever its origin, rotation and scale.

## Remarks

A negative scale mirrors a sprite about its origin instead, so it moves unless the origin is at its center.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="none"></a>`None = 0` | The image as it is. |
| <a name="horizontal"></a>`Horizontal = 1` | Left and right swapped. |
| <a name="vertical"></a>`Vertical = 2` | Top and bottom swapped. |
| <a name="both"></a>`Both = Horizontal \| Vertical` | Both: the image turned half a turn. |
